vulnerability.name: CVE-2020-24356
vulnerability.description: cloudflared before 2020.8.1: local privilege escalation on Windows

statements.impact_statement: The image bundles the cloudflared release current at build time (2026.10.7 or newer), years past the fix in 2020.8.1; scanners match the advisory because Cloudflare's build embeds a v0.0.0 pseudo-version in the binary. The advisory also concerns Windows only, and this is a Linux image.
statements.action_statement: None needed. The Release workflow attaches this statement to every published image.
